datasets.name: LongMemEval cleaned
datasets.data_nature: Curated questions over synthesized/assembled timestamped user-assistant histories; not a released dump of real PA conversations
datasets.reported_scale: 500 questions; 30 abstention items; oracle/S/M are alternative histories for the same question bank
datasets.data_license: Review dataset-card and component-corpus licenses; do not inherit code MIT automatically
datasets.implementation_status: collector + JSON importer + schema unit tests; full dataset not acquired/run
notes: Cleaned vs original histories are different revisions
Exclude _abs questions from positive evidence-retrieval denominators
Oracle is a separate upper-bound track
Official semantic judge is external; EM/F1 diagnostic is not official accuracy

datasets.name: LoCoMo
datasets.data_nature: LLM-generated multi-session dialogue benchmark with curated QA, not real-user logs
datasets.reported_scale: 10 released conversations in locomo10.json; count actual imported questions rather than copying repack totals
datasets.implementation_status: collector + strict text-only importer + schema tests; full data not acquired/run
notes: Raw file metadata verified: 2805274 bytes; Git blob d95b872480b413d935821fdc3c84f8a8f5f29e73
Preserve raw numeric category and upstream evidence ids
Do not ingest gold event summaries or claim photo reasoning from captions
Noncommercial terms need review for commercial evaluation

datasets.name: PersonaMem v1
datasets.data_nature: Synthetic personas and generated multi-session conversations
datasets.reported_scale: 32K / 128K / 1M context variants; variants/persona-history orders are not independent people
datasets.implementation_status: 32K collector + CSV/JSONL importer + schema tests; full data not acquired/run
notes: Use context[:end_index_in_shared_context], exclusive prefix
Never provide persona gold labels as observed history
MCQ requires exact option; parser differs deliberately from upstream permissive extraction

datasets.name: PersonaMem v2
datasets.reported_scale: 1000 personas, 20000+ preferences, 300+ scenarios advertised across release; test split is not all generated users
datasets.data_license: Not independently verified in this build
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; use original dataset and runner
notes: Do not count train/dev/test as independent test cases
Ask-to-forget behavior is not proof of physical storage deletion

datasets.name: PersonaMem v3
datasets.data_nature: Real-source-derived: anonymized engagement histories from GIST; generated personas and simulated app histories are derivative, not untouched real logs
datasets.reported_scale: 200 real-world source users / ~4M engagements reported; published HF sample is not that entire history
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; no data redistributed or evaluated
notes: Separate real-source observations from synthetic augmentation
Noncommercial restriction matters for commercial PA evaluation
Exclude persona_html/preferences/preference_details if they encode target labels rather than observations

datasets.name: MemoryAgentBench
datasets.data_nature: Heterogeneous existing datasets plus controlled synthetic tasks
datasets.reported_scale: 146 HF rows, ~76.6 MB; a row can hold many questions, so rows != tests
datasets.data_license: MIT on dataset card; inspect component-source terms
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; incremental replay adapter required
notes: Incremental ingestion is part of the protocol
LongMemEval-derived samples overlap; deduplicate across suites
Conflict resolution/forgetting terminology does not establish privacy-erasure testing

datasets.name: PrecisionMemBench
datasets.reported_scale: 35 seeded beliefs; 77 single-turn cases; 12 additional turn assertions in 2 session scenarios
datasets.implementation_status: 77-case source field projection bundled and run; session scenarios not bundled/run
notes: All questions/assertions transcribed from pinned upstream; original bytes not fetched
1 vacuous case unscored, not free success
Tiered/pinned/alias expectations contain architecture-specific policy
This is not official upstream provider scoring or a universal PA ranking

datasets.name: BEAM
datasets.data_nature: Automatically generated coherent conversations with validated probing questions
datasets.data_license: Repository MIT; check any dataset-specific terms before redistribution
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; full-history stress runner not executed
notes: Token scale is not number of users
Subsets/caches need explicit identification
Do not regenerate new chat histories and call them the released test set

datasets.name: PerLTQA
datasets.data_nature: Constructed personal semantic/episodic memory benchmark; inspect release artifacts for annotation protocol
datasets.reported_scale: Paper reports 8593 questions over 30 characters; 2025-12-22 revision fixes inconsistencies
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; pin corrected revision before ingest
notes: Paper count and revised file count may differ
Do not silently translate English benchmarks and claim native Chinese coverage

datasets.name: LifeBench v2.0
datasets.data_nature: Life-event simulator generated histories for virtual users; Chinese and English translations
datasets.reported_scale: 10 virtual users; 3380 questions per language; 47409 phone records; 57486 events; 9 sources
datasets.data_license: Not independently verified in this build
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; upstream LifeBench_eval recommended
notes: Default source branch resolved by connector as lifebench2.0
LoCoMo export is the same 3380 questions, not an extra benchmark
Do not ingest simulator persona/event trees containing privileged labels
English/Chinese versions are paired, not independent users

datasets.name: AMA-Bench
datasets.data_nature: Agent-trajectory memory QA; source trajectories and task environments must remain identified
datasets.reported_scale: Project reports 2482 evaluation questions; inspect current release counts rather than third-party conversions
datasets.data_license: Not independently verified in this build
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; trajectory adapter not implemented
notes: Official test path includes test/open_end_qa_set.jsonl
Do not flatten entire tool trajectory into a fake chat without disclosure
Open-answer and MCQ protocols remain separate

datasets.name: MemoryArena
datasets.data_nature: Human-crafted interdependent tasks in executable environments; observed rollouts depend on the agent
datasets.reported_scale: Several task environments; one source test is not interchangeable with a QA row
datasets.data_license: Dataset CC-BY-4.0 on project site; code/dependency licenses separately
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; retain upstream environment runners
notes: Repo marks code preview
Task→memory→action→environment→observation/reward is an interactive loop
Native task completion/reward is the primary score
Do not feed future success trajectories or evaluator gold as past memory

datasets.name: LongMemEval-V2
datasets.data_nature: 451 manually curated questions over multimodal web-agent trajectory histories in web/enterprise environments
datasets.reported_scale: 451 questions; up to500 trajectories/haystack; largest115M tokens; small/medium tiers
datasets.data_license: Repository Apache-2.0; verify separate data-card terms
datasets.implementation_status: source registry only; upstream multimodal/fixed-reader harness recommended
notes: Official query receives only question and optional image; metadata and labels private
Fixed reader and token budget crucial
Do not claim screenshots are evaluated by text-only importers
Upstream accuracy/latency frontier metric should not be replaced by our diagnostic pass rate

framework_references.use: Delegate interactive environments; do not flatten into QA

framework_references.name: OmniMemEval
framework_references.use: Broad suite inventory/runner reference; schemas and revision require independent integration review

framework_references.name: Agent Memory Benchmark
framework_references.use: Existing multi-mode framework reference; do not copy its provider results as our measurements
